notes: Field events are never about you any more. The whole-field detector already skipped the pace car and anyone in the pits; it now skips your own car too. Alone on track at Virginia the only car in the field was you, so one off-track was logged three times - once correctly as your own moment and twice as a field event about you, which the race reel cuts from an outside camera. Brake-point drill results reach the leaderboard again: the server accepted five drill names while the app offers six, so every brake-point attempt was rejected and earned nothing (fixed on the server, no install needed for that part). Also in this build, from 0.9.158 and 0.9.159: all four braking-light cases (a corner your reference takes flat is green when you take it flat, amber or red when you brake there, and taking a braking corner flat is judged on the time you gained or lost); field events no longer logged twice; your desktop can no longer end up in a highlight clip; SMART remembers the brake bias you actually ran, read live from the car; the finished video is named and opened from the Highlights panel; the Stint and Corners windows show the turns that fit with the one you are approaching in the middle; the Stint and Drill panels scale their text; the radar redraws at 33 ms; iRacing qualifying no longer calls cars closing behind you; and the chequered flag waits until you cross the line.
